description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sisilasagama & Chithrakala, Hambanthota D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830013 (Block 10)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
